name: Treadmill walk or cross trainer
how: Raises your heart rate and blood flow.

name: Arm circles
how: Forward, then backward. Loosens the shoulders.

name: Band pull-aparts
how: No band? Just squeeze your shoulder blades. Warms the rear delts and rotator cuff.

name: Push-ups
how: Slow and controlled. Wakes up chest, triceps and shoulders.

name: Light lateral raises
how: Warms up the side delts.

name: Warm-up set
how: One light set of your first exercise.

name: Doorway chest stretch
how: Arm on the door frame at 90°, lean forward through it.

name: Overhead triceps stretch
how: Arm overhead, bend the elbow, push it down with your other hand.

name: Cross-body shoulder stretch
how: Pull your arm across your body with the other hand.

name: Chest opener
how: Clasp your hands behind your back, lift your arms and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: Neck rolls
how: Slow circles, both directions.

name: Rowing machine or cross trainer
how: Raises your heart rate and wakes up your back.

name: Arm circles
how: Forward, then backward. Loosens the shoulders.

name: Cat-cow
how: On hands and knees. Loosens the spine.

name: Band pull-aparts
how: Wakes up the rear delts and rhomboids.

name: Straight arm pulldown
how: Light cable or band. Wakes up the lats.

name: Warm-up set
how: One light set of your first exercise.

name: Lat stretch
how: Grab a pole or door frame overhead and lean away from it.

name: Child's pose
how: Kneel, sit back on your heels, reach your arms forward on the floor.

name: Biceps wall stretch
how: Arm straight against the wall, palm flat, turn your body away.

name: Upper trap stretch
how: Tilt your head to the side and gently pull with your hand.

name: Thread the needle
how: On all fours, reach one arm under your body and rotate.

name: Incline walk or cycling
how: Raises your heart rate and warms up your legs.

name: Hip circles
how: Standing. Loosens the hips.

name: Leg swings
how: Front to back, then side to side.

name: Glute bridges
how: Bodyweight, squeeze at the top.

name: Bodyweight squats
how: Slow, full depth. Grooves the squat pattern.

name: Walking lunges
how: Bodyweight. Warms knees, hips, quads and glutes.

name: Squat warm-up sets
how: Two light sets before your working sets.

name: Standing quad stretch
how: Stand on one leg, pull your foot to your glute, knees together.

name: Standing hamstring stretch
how: Foot on a bench, lean forward with a straight back.

name: Pigeon pose
how: Front leg bent at 90°, back leg straight behind you, lean forward.

name: Hip flexor stretch
how: Lunge with your back knee down, push your hips forward.

name: Butterfly stretch
how: Sit with the soles of your feet together, gently push your knees down.

name: Calf stretch
how: Foot against the wall, lean in with your heel down.
